items.title: The Interface pilot that died so a new one could live
items.summary: Somewhere in your company, there’s probably a circular economy initiative, such as a reusable packaging trial or a take-back program for used products, that quietly disappeared without an official end.

items.title: Of these 8 corporate climate strategies, only 1 is linked to falling emissions
items.summary: Companies can pull multiple levers in a bid to cut emissions, from developing a climate strategy to linking executive compensation to sustainability goals.

items.title: The four packaging and sustainability bills that could disrupt your compliance strategy
items.summary: The opinions expressed by Trellis expert contributors are their own, not those of Trellis.

items.title: New US data centres will emit more carbon than Mexico, research finds
items.summary: New US data centres would emit 2.1 billion metric tonnes of carbon dioxide by 2030, more than the country of Mexico, according to new data from environmental non-profit, the Sierra Club.

items.title: Less than 1% of climate finance reaches smallholders, ministers warn
items.summary: Ministers from six countries have warned that just 0.8% of climate finance reaches smallholders, calling for changes to how funding is distributed as countries struggle to meet global biodiversity targets ahead of the 2030 deadline.

items.title: COP31 energy push: Clean power funding lags as Presidency targets building efficiency
items.summary: With the climate summit around the corner, analysis shows that less than half of fossil fuel public finance cuts is being redirected into clean energy, while the Presidency has launched a new initiative to scale electrification and green buildings.

items.title: WEBINAR NEXT WEEK: What SMEs need to know before investing in solar
items.summary: Taking place on 5 November, this upcoming webinar will explore how SMEs can overcome the financial and practical barriers to onsite solar and maximise the return on their investment.

items.title: On-demand webinar: How AI can unlock investment in climate solutions
items.summary: Discover how businesses can use AI, market intelligence and expert insight to identify credible climate investment opportunities, strengthen financial business cases and turn sustainability ambitions into funded action.

items.title: WEBINAR ON 10 NOVEMBER: How to prepare for the UK SRS
items.summary: This webinar, hosted in partnership with Simply Sustainable on 10 November, will explore how businesses can prepare for the UK Sustainability Reporting Standards (UK SRS), understand their current level of readiness and turn gaps into a practical implementation plan.

items.title: Win a free VIP pass to edie 27: Take our sustainability snapshot survey
items.summary: Sustainability professionals have the chance to win six months of access to edie’s digital Membership offering as well as a VIP pass to edie 27 in April by completing a short survey.
